supplements.title: Newly isolated human-derived Lactobacillus fermentum strain stimulates IFN-γ-secreting CD8+ T cells for enhanced anti-cancer immunity.
supplements.summary: A probiotic bacterium (Lactobacillus fermentum MI37) enhances cancer immunotherapy by activating immune cells through a specific bacterial component called lipoteichoic acid.

supplements.title: The 'Tianyu' Formulation Alleviates Rheumatoid Arthritis by Modulating the NLRP3/Caspase-1/GSDMD-Mediated Pyroptosis Pathway.
supplements.summary: The 'Tianyu' herbal formulation reduces rheumatoid arthritis inflammation by blocking a key cell death pathway involving NLRP3, Caspase-1, and GSDMD proteins.

supplements.title: Apoptotic/cell cycle arrest potential of dusty miller methanol extract against Paca-2 pancreatic cancer cells via upregulating Bax/Bcl2: A HPLC-ESI-MS/MS, GNPS-based molecular networking and network pharmacology studies.
supplements.summary: Dusty miller extract kills pancreatic cancer cells by triggering apoptosis and stopping cell growth through key protein targets.

supplements.title: Luteolin Ameliorates Sepsis-Induced Acute Lung Injury by Targeting RPTPα to Reprogram Macrophage M1-M2 Polarization.
supplements.summary: Luteolin, a natural compound, reduces lung inflammation in sepsis by targeting a protein that reprograms immune cells from pro-inflammatory to anti-inflammatory states.

supplements.title: Resveratrol-loaded liposomes regulate mitochondrial oxidative stress through the HIGD1A/NF-κB/SOD2 signaling pathway to improve chemotherapy-induced ovarian injury.
supplements.summary: Resveratrol-loaded liposomes protect ovarian cells from chemotherapy damage by reducing oxidative stress through a specific cellular pathway.

supplements.title: Hydroxytyrosol suppressed the nephrotoxicity of cisplatin while supporting its therapeutic potential in a rat model of hepatocellular carcinoma.
supplements.summary: Hydroxytyrosol protects kidneys from cisplatin damage while enhancing its cancer-fighting effect against hepatocellular carcinoma.

supplements.title: Mechanistic insights into ferroptosis in thyroid cancer and its therapeutic implications.
supplements.summary: Triggering ferroptosis, an iron-dependent cell death pathway, shows promise for treating thyroid cancer and overcoming radioiodine resistance.

supplements.title: Identification of natural compounds targeting the KRAS G12D mutation in pancreatic cancer through integrated in silico and in vitro approaches.
supplements.summary: Researchers identified natural compounds mangiferin and hesperetin that effectively block a common pancreatic cancer mutation, showing promise in early tests.

supplements.title: Sijunzi Decoction Reverses Metabolic Adaptation and Induces Ferroptosis in Cisplatin-Resistant Non-small Cell Lung Cancer: An Integrative Metabolomics-Pharmacology Analysis.
supplements.summary: Sijunzi Decoction overcomes drug resistance in lung cancer by blocking metabolic changes that help cancer cells survive chemotherapy.

supplements.title: The interplay of Ashwagandha with hormonal dynamics and gut microbiota in women with breast cancer: a tri-axial perspective.
supplements.summary: Ashwagandha may help fight breast cancer by suppressing tumor growth, boosting immune response, and altering gut bacteria, though clinical testing is needed.

supplements.title: Natural Products as Modulators of ABC Transporters in Breast Cancer.
supplements.summary: Natural plant products can inhibit drug-resistant breast cancer by blocking transporters that remove chemotherapy drugs from cancer cells.

supplements.title: Diet and risk of multiple myeloma: findings from a case-control study.
supplements.summary: Healthier diets reduce multiple myeloma risk, while inflammatory and insulin-promoting diets increase risk.

supplements.title: Liquorice alters adipocyte-breast cancer cell crosstalk by modulating oxidative stress and suppressing aromatase and renin-angiotensin signalling.
supplements.summary: Liquorice root extract reduces breast cancer cell growth by altering fat cell signals that normally promote tumors.

supplements.title: Neuroprotective effects of quercetin in animal models of neurodegenerative diseases: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
supplements.summary: Quercetin, a plant compound, improved memory and reduced brain inflammation and oxidative stress in animal models of neurodegenerative diseases.

supplements.title: Expressional deregulations of RET/PTC genes and different nutritional factors playing crucial role in the development of thyroid cancer in Pakistani female subjects.
supplements.summary: Thyroid cancer in Pakistani women may result from abnormal RET gene activity combined with poor dietary habits.

off_label.title: Dopamine D2 Receptor Agonists as Modulators of VEGF-A-Driven Angiogenesis: Mechanisms, Clinical Evidence, and Translational Opportunities.
off_label.summary: Dopamine D2 receptor agonists suppress tumor blood vessel growth by blocking VEGF-A signaling, offering a potential new cancer treatment approach.

off_label.title: Simvastatin Restores Cisplatin Sensitivity by Suppressing the Caveolin-1-Mediated PI3K/AKT Signaling Pathway in Cisplatin-Resistant Cervical Cancer Cells.
off_label.summary: Simvastatin restores cisplatin effectiveness in resistant cervical cancer by blocking a key resistance pathway, suggesting it could improve chemotherapy outcomes.

off_label.title: Nintedanib is a potent FLT3 inhibitor with activity against FLT3-ITD and overcomes the gatekeeper F691L resistance mutation in acute myeloid leukemia.
off_label.summary: Nintedanib, a lung disease drug, effectively treats acute myeloid leukemia by blocking FLT3 mutations, even resistant ones.

off_label.title: Toremifene in desmoid fibromatosis: Prospective phase 2 study of two dose levels.
off_label.summary: A study tested whether toremifene, an existing drug, safely and effectively treats desmoid fibromatosis at different dose levels.

off_label.title: ICMT supports BRAFV600E-driven tumor growth by membrane targeting of the CAAX protein INPP5E.
off_label.summary: Blocking ICMT protein in melanoma prevents a cancer-supporting protein from reaching cell membranes, slowing tumor growth.

off_label.title: Preemptive cardioprotection with a small molecule in rodents that suppresses genes predictive of heart failure.
off_label.summary: A small molecule drug given before heart surgery reduced heart damage by 70% and prevented heart failure in rats by suppressing inflammation.

off_label.title: Orlistat potentiates the gemcitabine effect in inhibiting the malignant biological behavior of nasopharyngeal carcinoma by downregulating PKM2.
off_label.summary: Adding the weight loss drug orlistat to gemcitabine chemotherapy improves treatment effectiveness against nasopharyngeal cancer by reducing a specific cancer-promoting protein.

off_label.title: HOXD11-NMDAR signaling drives neuroendocrine prostate cancer and enables potential therapeutic intervention as a target of memantine.
off_label.summary: HOXD11 drives treatment-resistant neuroendocrine prostate cancer, and the drug memantine may block this transformation by targeting NMDAR signaling.

off_label.title: Long-term add-on fibrate therapy in Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis: Safety, biochemical response, and disease progression.
off_label.summary: Long-term fibrate treatment appears safe and may slow disease progression in Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis patients.

off_label.title: Implications of Glucagon-Like Peptide-1 Receptor Agonists in Otolaryngology - Head and Neck Surgery: A Review.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists show mixed effects in head and neck health, potentially helping sleep apnea and hearing loss while raising concerns about reflux, hearing changes, and possible thyroid cancer risk.

off_label.title: Sodium-glucose cotransporter 2 inhibitors and the risk of kidney cancer among patients with type 2 diabetes: a population-based cohort study.
off_label.summary: SGLT2 inhibitors may reduce kidney cancer risk in type 2 diabetes patients compared to alternative diabetes medications.

off_label.title: Timing and duration of glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist use and risk of nonarteritic anterior ischaemic optic neuropathy.
off_label.summary: GLP-1 receptor agonists, used for diabetes, may increase the risk of a type of vision loss called nonarteritic anterior ischemic optic neuropathy.

off_label.title: Dual Targeting Strategy: Colchicine and Paclitaxel Combination Against Prostate Cancer Cells Colchicine-Paclitaxel Synergy in Prostate Cancer.
off_label.summary: Combining colchicine and paclitaxel drugs shows promise against drug-resistant prostate cancer cells in laboratory studies.

off_label.title: Brain FGF2 and NCAM1 contribute to FGFR1-dependent progression of ER+ breast cancer brain metastases in young and aged hosts
off_label.summary: FGFR1-amplified ER+ breast cancer spreads to the brain through FGF2 and NCAM1 signaling, which FGFR inhibitors can block early.

off_label.title: Soluble Uric Acid Drives CD8⁺ T-cell Exhaustion by Inducing KSR1-Mediated MAPK Hyperactivation.
off_label.summary: High uric acid exhausts immune cells in colorectal cancer; lowering it restores anti-tumor immunity and enhances immunotherapy effectiveness.

biomarkers.title: Bevacizumab induces apoptosis in glioblastoma cells by upregulating miR-4695-5p to inhibit PKMYT1.
biomarkers.summary: Bevacizumab kills glioblastoma cancer cells by increasing a molecule that blocks a protein preventing cell death.

biomarkers.title: LncRNA MIR4435-2HG-mediated succinylation of USF1 promotes its protein stability and induces epithelial-mesenchymal transition in HNSCC.
biomarkers.summary: A gene called MIR4435-2HG promotes head and neck cancer spread by stabilizing a protein that triggers invasive cell behavior.

biomarkers.title: Advancing Antibody-Drug Conjugates: Current Perspectives and Future Directions.
biomarkers.summary: Antibody-drug conjugates selectively deliver cancer drugs to tumor cells, with combinations and new designs improving effectiveness and overcoming treatment resistance.

biomarkers.title: Translating Innovation Into Practice: Dissemination of Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors and Their Toxicity Management Across the Globe.
biomarkers.summary: Immune checkpoint inhibitors show similar effectiveness at lower doses, improving affordability and safety while reducing side effects globally.

biomarkers.title: Surgical and Oncologic Outcomes After Pancreatectomy for Pancreatic Neuroendocrine Tumor in Multiple Endocrine Neoplasia Type 1 and von Hippel-Lindau Syndrome: A Large, Multi-Institutional, Cohort Study.
biomarkers.summary: Surgery for pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors shows different outcomes in patients with genetic syndromes versus sporadic cases.

biomarkers.title: Mucinase-engineered cell membrane nanovesicles degrade the glycocalyx shield to potentiate antitumor immunity.
biomarkers.summary: Engineered nanovesicles break down tumor's protective mucin shield, enhancing immune cell attack on colorectal and breast cancers.

biomarkers.title: NAT10/ac4C drives intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma by suppressing transposable elements via chromatin remodeling.
biomarkers.summary: NAT10 protein drives intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma growth by suppressing immune responses through RNA modifications and chromatin changes.

biomarkers.title: A broad-spectrum inhibitor of copper-exporting P1B-type ATPases.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers discovered MKV3, a drug that blocks copper-transporting proteins, potentially offering a new way to treat copper-related diseases.

biomarkers.title: NEK2 drives pathogenesis, drug resistance, and LMP1 expression in EBV-positive non-Hodgkin lymphoma.
biomarkers.summary: NEK2 inhibition kills EBV-positive lymphoma cells, reduces drug resistance, and improves survival in mouse models.

biomarkers.title: Scientific highlights and perspectives from the International Inflammatory Breast Cancer Symposium 2025.
biomarkers.summary: Experts convened to advance inflammatory breast cancer treatment through molecular profiling, trimodal therapy optimization, and emerging detection technologies.

biomarkers.title: [Clinical analysis of six patients with pyruvate kinase deficiency caused by PKLR variants].
biomarkers.summary: Researchers studied six patients with pyruvate kinase deficiency caused by PKLR gene mutations to understand symptoms, treatment options, and disease outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Clinical benefit and predictors of response to momelotinib after ruxolitinib failure: A cooperative real-world study.
biomarkers.summary: Momelotinib effectively treats myelofibrosis patients who failed previous ruxolitinib therapy, offering a viable second-line option.

biomarkers.title: A venetoclax-cytarabine-based induction regimen incorporating a translation inhibitor for adult patients with de novo acute myeloid leukemia.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers found a new drug combination using venetoclax, cytarabine, and a translation inhibitor may help treat acute myeloid leukemia more effectively.

biomarkers.title: Germline genetic testing among patients with pancreatic adenocarcinoma: A Pancreatic Cancer Action Network patient survey.
biomarkers.summary: About 10-15% of pancreatic cancer patients carry inherited genetic mutations, making universal genetic testing recommended for all patients.

biomarkers.title: Dopamine D2 Receptor Agonists as Modulators of VEGF-A-Driven Angiogenesis: Mechanisms, Clinical Evidence, and Translational Opportunities.
biomarkers.summary: Dopamine D2 receptor agonists suppress tumor blood vessel growth by blocking VEGF-A signaling, offering a potential new cancer treatment approach.

trials.summary: Surgery for pancreatic neuroendocrine tumors shows different outcomes in patients with genetic syndromes versus sporadic cases.

trials.summary: Experts convened to advance inflammatory breast cancer treatment through molecular profiling, trimodal therapy optimization, and emerging detection technologies.

trials.title: A Phase II Evaluation of the Efficacy and Safety of Sacituzumab Govitecan in Patients with Recurrent Uterine Cancer.
trials.summary: A new drug called sacituzumab govitecan shows promise treating advanced uterine cancer patients who didn't respond to previous treatments.

trials.summary: Momelotinib effectively treats myelofibrosis patients who failed previous ruxolitinib therapy, offering a viable second-line option.

trials.summary: Researchers found a new drug combination using venetoclax, cytarabine, and a translation inhibitor may help treat acute myeloid leukemia more effectively.

trials.title: Distinct cytokines regulate gene expression and anti-tumor activity in regenerated CD8+ T cells from induced pluripotent stem cells.
trials.summary: IL-15 and IL-7 enhance the anti-tumor activity of lab-grown immune cells created from stem cells.

trials.title: Association of baseline eosinophil counts with clinical prognosis in cancer patients undergoing immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.
trials.summary: Higher baseline eosinophil counts predict better survival and treatment response in cancer patients receiving immune checkpoint inhibitor therapy.

trials.title: Endothelial-derived PANoptosis factor IL33 is a potential immunotherapy in breast cancer.
trials.summary: IL-33 from breast cancer blood vessel cells could improve immunotherapy by enhancing immune cell activity against tumors.

trials.title: Inhibiting MDM2 enhances RIPK3-mediated necroptosis and synergizes with immune checkpoint blockade therapy.
trials.summary: Blocking MDM2 boosts tumor cell death and enhances immunotherapy effectiveness by activating immune responses against cancer.

trials.title: Prognostic impact of ASXL1 mutations in acute myeloid leukemia treated with lower intensity therapy.
trials.summary: ASXL1 mutations in acute myeloid leukemia no longer predict poor outcomes when treated with newer lower-intensity venetoclax-based therapies.

trials.title: Dormancy exit correlates with CREB1 reactivation that is a potential target to overcome endocrine therapy resistance in ER+ breast cancer cells.
trials.summary: CREB1 reactivation drives ER+ breast cancer dormancy exit and endocrine therapy resistance, making it a promising treatment target.

trials.title: Synergistic Effects of DNA-PKcs Inhibition and Radiotherapy in Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma.
trials.summary: Blocking DNA-PKcs protein makes esophageal cancer cells significantly more sensitive to radiation therapy by preventing DNA repair.
